entities.name: Rocío Sánchez Moccia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rocío Sánchez Moccia is an Argentine field hockey player. She competed for the Argentina national team, winning two silver medals at the 2012 and 2020 Summer Olympics and a bronze at the 2024 Summer Olympics.
